title: Augusteum, so-called Basilica at Herculaneum
description: The Augusteum, or so-called "Basilica", at Herculaneum, was partially investigated in the eighteenth century. This large complex (68 by 40 meters) had colonnades on three of its sides and faced onto the Decumanus Maximus across from the Basilica Noniana and the College of the Augustales.

properties.description: The scant visible remains of the Auguseum complex at located at the northwestern limit of Herculaneum's archaeological area.
